a.lede: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has until the end of the day Wednesday to answer a call from House Republicans for a closed-door briefing on his affair with alleged Chinese spy.
a.title: Congress to call Jensen Huang in to answer for alleged Chinese spy affair

b.lede: Jensen Huang is being investigated by his own company over an extramarital affair with a woman alleged to be a Chinese spy.
b.title: Zoe Kleinman: Nvidia CEO's affair will cause ripples across US and beyond
